a.text: A fresh, fragrant breeze billows in the grove by the starlight, and Philomel's night-song echoes; the shepherdess, alas! perceives it not.

b.text: A fresh fragrant rustling wafts in the grove by the light of the stars, and Philomel's night-song resounds; the shepherdess, alas! does not hear it.

a.text: Angered, the elves are seen wandering, that desire breaks the flower of chastity; laments are heard echoing in the grove; the shepherdess, alas! perceives them not.

b.text: One sees the elves drift about in anger, because pleasure breaks the flower of chastity; one hears laments echo in the grove; the shepherdess, alas! does not hear them.

a.text: Yet at last, in the shimmer of the moon, she was seen upon the shepherd's arm: the elves' funerary wailing sounds where they walk intoxicated in the valley.

b.text: But at last she was seen in the shimmer of the moon on the shepherd's arm: the elves' grave-whimpering sounds where, intoxicated, she walks in the valley.

a.text: Her purple girdle flutters in the wind, her eye swims in moist radiance; she sighs, 'O! sweet shepherd, where do I now find the lily-wreath of innocence?'

b.text: Her purple girdle flutters in the wind, her eye swims in moist radiance; she sighs, "Oh! sweet shepherd, where shall I now find the lily-wreath of innocence?"

a.text: 'Among crowns that adorn corpses,' thus it whimpers in the misty valley;

b.text: By crowns that adorn corpses, so it whimpers in the misty valley;
